messages.text: If the wind lays down by Saturday, Lost Valley before breakfast?
That sounds right. After today I just want trees and no engines for a while.
Watch 94 coming back. I saw two deer on the shoulder by the winery bend.
Yep. I'll have Dale across the road keep an eye on the porch box if we leave early.
That washer noise sounds like the pump bearing. If it quits, don't let the shop sell you a whole new unit.
I priced the pump at $137. Even if labor runs high, the side account can take a hit like that.
Good. Keep the receipt and I'll look at the old one Sunday if you want.
Thanks. I am trying not to touch the work-payroll piece unless we absolutely have to.
Those new black work ones still holding up, or are the soles going flat already?
County page says they are taking comments Thursday about the road shop bid. Same outfit that messed up the plows last winter?
Still better than the old pair. After the Amazon-heavy loop today I noticed the difference getting out of the truck.
Looks like it. I may stop by after route and say the county crew should keep that work. Cheaper on paper is not always cheaper after two storms.
That is usually how it goes. I still do not trust either mailer we got today.
Rotate them if you can. Once the heel wears crooked, everything above it starts working harder.
Same. I marked the sample ballot one line at a time and ignored the slogans.
Yeah, I set the brown pair by the door for tomorrow. Not cheaping out on that again.
Did that little card reader I gave you still work?
Yep. I pulled the creek shots off it tonight and have the old Wilco record going in the office.
Good. Keep the good ones backed up somewhere besides that card.
Already copied them over. Just picking through the crooked ones now.
I found your old folder in the cedar chest. The hospital card from Washington is in there, plus the little photo from the porch on Highway F.
Thanks. I can swing by Sunday after lunch and look through it.
Your father says the porch photo was before we fixed the gravel drive near Defiance, so do not let him argue the year.
I remember that drive more than the porch. Tell Dad I will bring the scanner.
Do you want me to save those wide-mouth jars from the basement shelf?
Yes please. I can use them for the counter jar and for the chopped stuff Emily and I take with lunch.
I also found the big ladle you left here after Christmas. I will set it by the door.
I found that old first-day photo of you with the satchel. Was that spring of 2017?
Yes, March. Hard to believe that scanner was the size of a brick compared with the new ones.
You looked so nervous. I also found a letter from your branch about payroll deductions starting that month.
Keep it in the folder with the pay stubs. I may need the dates for the station paperwork.
Are you still coming by to look at that insurance letter tonight?
I found another one of those thick paperbacks you like in the church sale box. It has a red planet on the cover.
Can we do tomorrow? I got home and sat down with my boots still on.
That sounds like something I would take. If it is not too beat up, set it aside for Sunday.
I put it by the kitchen phone with the other books for you.
That is fine. I wondered when your replies got so short this afternoon. Put the envelope by the coffee pot so I do not misplace it.
Thanks. I kept rereading the account number and the dates and wasn't making much progress.
If the rain holds off Saturday, want to hit Lewis and Clark before lunch?
That works. I am keeping the weekend simple after this route week.
Same. I will bring the poles if your knee is still talking after parcels.
Appreciate it. Emily may do coffee after, but I am not making it a whole outing.
You still reading that article Emily sent about the South City stop?
Yeah. I had to slow down on it. The part about who got written up and who got sent home was hard to shake.
Same. The camera gap bothered me more than the clip itself.
I sent $15 to that neighborhood legal fund and saved the follow-up piece for after dinner.
I saw the tire charge clear. Want me to start chili instead of meeting at the tavern?
Yes, that helps. I can grab beans on the way home and leave the lure kit sitting in the online cart.
Good plan. I will thaw the ground beef and we can look at the March list after dinner.
That little meter you borrowed still giving weird numbers?
Found a Reddit thread with the same board and a YouTube clip where the guy tests the pins one by one. Going to try that before I blame the meter.
Good. Slow and steady. Send me the clip if it shows a clean way to hold the lead.
Will do. I also saved a short lens side-by-side from the same channel, so my tabs are a mess tonight.
My paycheck hit this morning. Want me to send the usual house amount now or wait until you finish the March rows?
Wait until tonight. Ameren came in a little lower and the insurance line changed, so I want the formula to settle first.
Okay. Just text me the final number and I’ll move it before dinner.
Thanks. I’ll check it after my route and make sure neither of us is covering too much this round.
You still on the St. Peters side or finally headed back?
Just cleared the last cul-de-sac. Scanner froze twice and the parcel tub was ridiculous today.
I put the ice pack on the top shelf. Take your shoes off before you start dinner, please.
Deal. My shoulders feel like I carried half of St. Charles County.
Tricia said they can do 6:45 tomorrow. Do we still have the little plastic trains in the blue box?
Yes, top shelf in the closet. I will grab snacks after work.
Good. Mike asked if we had room for one more map or if the bird one is already taking the table.
We can fit both if I move the mail bin and use the card table for drinks.
Saw the truck come through late. Long one?
Yeah. I parked by the Missouri after and walked the path a bit.
Good. Better than sitting in the driveway staring at the dash.
Took the camera too. Got a decent shot of the barge lights and roughed it out in the pocket pad.
You got the game on or are you still out running errands?
Just got home. TV is on now, bottom of the 3rd.
That double off the wall was nice. Dad would have been hollering at the screen.
I did enough hollering for both of us. Wearing the red STL cap must be helping.
You still taking the 6-10 parcel help this morning?
Yeah. Puts me just over 46 for the week, but it covers the truck sensor bill.
Got it. I'll grab the east rack so you aren't stuck sorting both sides.
Appreciate it. I want to be out by 10:15 if the scanner behaves.
How did 63G treat you after they moved those Amazon tubs?
Better after I put the Maple Ridge parcels behind the left tray. The scanner had me backtracking last week, so I wrote the stop order in my book.
Smart. That cul-de-sac eats time if you hit it after the condos.
Exactly. I still checked the smalls twice before I left because one wrong bundle ruins the whole swing.
You still want me to look at that downspout by the back steps today?
Yes, after Emily gets back from Aldi. I already moved the ladder and swept the porch.
Good. Bring out the bit set too. That bracket is probably loose from the freeze.
Will do. I need to finish the lender portal password reset before lunch, then I am free.
Dad said the pharmacy bag is still on the counter. You heading that way before lunch?
Yeah. I told Mom I'd grab it, then bring them sandwiches.
Thanks. I can stop tomorrow and look at that cabinet door if the old man hasn't already taken it apart.
He probably has. Same guy who let me hold the flashlight while you were still too short to reach the mower hood.
Dad wants to know if you still have that foam roller. He said yours is the one that actually feels like it does something.
I do. It is next to the work boots. I have been using it after the route before I sit down.
Smart. Those truck steps plus all the porch stairs add up.
Yeah, if I skip the floor stuff, the couch locks me up and the stairs feel worse the next morning.
Honey, your dad said the parcel loads sounded awful this week. Did you get any real rest last night?
Not much. I heard every furnace click and truck on the road. I put the phone in the kitchen but still woke up before 4.
Come by after your route if you want. I can keep lunch simple, and no need to look at the news while you are here.
That sounds good. A quiet hour after work would help.
Are you still bringing the foil pan tomorrow? I can make the potatoes if you are doing the slow stuff.
Yes. I already rubbed the two racks and put them in the fridge. I'll also bring the quick pieces Emily likes.
That helps. Your father said to bring your long tongs too, since ours disappeared after Christmas.
Packed them by the cooler. I'll start the smaller batch once we get there so it doesn't dry out.
Did Dr. Kline say anything different than the county notice I printed?
Are you and Emily still coming Sunday? I can move lunch later if your route was rough this week.
We are coming. Emily already wrote down what you need from Schnucks.
Pretty close. He said wait for the March batch unless work offers it sooner.
Good. She asked me yesterday if you had been sleeping enough. I told her to make you sit down before you start fixing things here.
Good. I trust his office more than all those forwarded posts.
She caught that before I said anything. I will behave and just carry the bags.
Same. I kept the Mercy FAQ too, just to compare dates.
I put the extra rice and chicken in the flat glass one so it fits in your blue bag.
Good call. Tomorrow looks packed and I may not sit down until after 1.
I added the last orange too. Please take more water than you think.
Already set two bottles by my keys so I don't talk myself into a quick stop.
If you come by after lunch, I'll leave the mower alone. The yellow dust is already thick on the hood.
Good call. I'll keep the windows up on the drive and bring the spray from the truck.
Rinse your face before you sit down inside. Your mother just wiped the porch chairs yesterday.
You going back to the school gym tonight or sitting this one out?
Maybe for a little. I told myself one run, no chasing every loose ball.
Good. Put the wrap in your bag and don't forget whatever Emily keeps by the coffee filters.
Already packed both. If it feels off after warmups, I'm heading home.
You still need that clamp for the tripod? I found one in my garage that might fit your older head.
Yeah, bring it Sunday if you remember. I'm trying to make the kit work without checking a second bag.
For that May thing with the lava fields and sideways rain, right?
That's the one. I keep looking at sample shots where the sky changes every ten minutes.
For Sunday lunch, should I put out the two green placemats for you and Emily?
That works. We'll bring the rolls and leave the extra chairs folded.
If you come by after lunch, Main Street has the school band outside the bakery again.
That could be worth bringing the small camera. I may take the river road over instead of 94.
Thank you. I moved the breakables back to the lower shelf, so no special clearing needed.
Good. We'll come straight from home after coffee.
Just watch the shoulder near the bend. The water was high when we crossed yesterday.
I will. If the clouds hold, I might stop ten minutes before your driveway.
Tasha said your parcel numbering trick saved her from looping back twice.
Good. I remember how dumb I felt my first March on that side of 94, so I wrote the turns the way I wish somebody had written them for me.
You still going to that class info thing after work Thursday?
Yeah. If I am going to keep fixing the same messes every morning, I should learn the bigger map instead of just patching my corner.
Your shoes and helmet are still by the back door. Want me to move them before I mop?
Leave them there. If the route doesn't run long tomorrow, I'll try for the Y lot again before dinner.
Forecast shows wind after 6. Pack the knee sleeve too, just in case.
Good call. I'll check with the early crew before I commit.
You got the game on or are you still sorting packages?
On now. Missed the first six minutes but saw the early power play.
That goalie bailed them out twice already.
Need one clean rush from Kyrou and this looks different.
Martha asked whether you could still come by on the 19th. She saved two bags of ribbon and those little wood frames.
I can do the 19th after my route if parcels don't run wild. I will sort the ribbon at home first so it is not a mess on her tables.
She also said the cereal shelf is light again, if you have room in the trunk.
I will bring a box from the garage and stop at the dollar store for tape and markers.
I saw the river picture you liked from that Augusta account. Was that near the old bakery?
Yes, I think so. Their IG story tagged the frame shop across the street, so I saved it for the next time Emily and I are out that way.
Pretty colors. Your father said you were also looking at a small part for your workbench.
Yep. Someone on Reddit posted the exact part number, then I checked a short YouTube walkthrough before ordering.
Do you still have that county page you printed? Your dad and I got the cards in the mail today.
Yes, I put mine in the kitchen folder. I can bring you a copy Sunday after I mark the water district and school board lines.
That would help. The little summaries in the paper were too short for me.
I saved the longer article from the county section too. I'll print both so you can read them side by side.
Mom found that reunion binder again. Mullins, Whitaker, Becker rows all labeled like somebody was grading it.
Bring it Sunday. Emily wants to scan the old farm picture before Mom tapes it to another poster board.
She also asked if we remember the first verse for the 10:30 thing. I remember enough to move my mouth.
Same. I'll help carry chairs and hum quietly. That is the full package.
Mom said their garage door guy might be $380 if the spring is shot. You two okay if they ask us to split it?
Yeah, our half would be fine. I would rather write them a check than have Dad mess with that spring.
Same. I'll wait for the estimate before saying anything.
Appreciate it. Emily and I just checked the months-ahead number last weekend, so one ugly bill won't wreck March.
Heads up, Dock 3 already has Hampstead and Dardenne stacked high.
Great. I'll stretch before I case anything. Yesterday's steps had my calves barking.
Take the lighter satchel first pass if you can. Wind is supposed to kick up near O'Fallon by noon.
Good call. I'll swap the scanner battery before I roll out.
You going to the branch meeting after casing? They are talking route inspections and the new scanner numbers.
Yes, staying for the first half. The numbers look clean until you see what they leave out.
No kidding. You still filling out that council card too?
Dropped it in my bag. I checked the candidates against what they have actually done, not what the flyers shout.
You get buried on parcels too or just me?
Buried. I am going to detour by the river before I head home.
Katy side or the little ramp?
Little ramp. Light should be good enough for a few photos, and I still have that folded page in my bag.
Route running late? I can start the rice if you grab the bathroom cleaner on the way.
Are you still out? I can start dinner later if the hill streets ran long.
Almost done. I had to walk one box to Mrs. Keller's side porch because the front steps were blocked, then rescan it at the door.
About 20 behind. I will stop at Schnucks and also pick up the furnace filters.
Good call. She would have called if it sat in the rain.
Thanks. I paid the county receipt from the escrow notice folder so it is off the pile.
Good. I will do the counters and stove after dinner.
That stop is in my notes now. It cost a few minutes, but it saves a complaint later.
Road dipped below freezing at our place. Take the lower curve slow.
I will. Saw tracks by the mailbox again, so I'm not pushing it before sunup.
Good. Your mother said Nancy's light was on when that pickup rolled past twice.
Dale already texted me about it. I'll check the porch camera after my first stop.
That book you left in the truck has a lot of diagrams for a story. You want it back before I clean out the cab?
Yes, leave it on the workbench if you do not mind. I am only halfway through the colony map section.
Workbench is fine. I will keep the oil rag away from it.
Need me to save those mower bolts for you, or did you already find the right size?
Save them. I wrote 5/16 twice and still kept checking the package.
Thanks. That paperback has already survived one coffee spill.
I will put them in the coffee can on the bench. You do not have to solve it tonight.
Good. I may just eat and stop moving for a bit when I get in.
That lid thermometer still reading high?
About 25 degrees high. I used the probe instead and kept the back burner low.
Good. Thin pieces first, then the bones can sit longer without you opening it every ten minutes.
Your mom said the county tax notice showed up. You still keeping those house numbers in one place?
Yeah, I added a line for it and linked it to the March total. It won't hit until April, but I wanted it visible.
Good. Easier to fix a number when you can see where it came from.
That's what I did tonight. Lemon pepper batch came off before the sauced ones needed the last wrap.
Exactly. Emily and I can look at the same total instead of guessing after the payment clears.
When you come Sunday, bring that little socket set. I can do the bench work if you handle the low cabinet.
I can, but I may take the tall stool instead of kneeling on the concrete.
Fine by me. Use your head. I will clear space so you are not twisted under there.
Appreciate it. I will do my band routine before I head over and bring the sleeve just in case.
You sounded wound up when you stopped by. Route still backed up?
Yeah, scanner issues and two streets of late parcels. My hands kept checking my pocket all evening, so I left the phone on the bench by the back door.
Good. Same as a bad mower belt: step away from the noise, then fix what you can.
I am going to pack tomorrow's lunch and call it early.
Still going down to Hermann next weekend or did you move it?
Moved it out. The inn let us slide the room, so Saturday is just yard work and sandwiches.
Probably not the worst. I can bring that socket set by, no need to buy the duplicate one you were talking about.
Perfect. I crossed that off for now.
You still going out by Defiance Saturday morning, or did the rain move that?
Watching the forecast. If the gravel dries, I want the out-and-back from the Katy lot before lunch.
Got it. I will swing by Mom's later then. Don't overdo it if your knee is barking.
Keeping it easy. Mostly need the miles after sitting in the truck all week.
You still want me to grab those gel inserts at Menards if I see them?
Yeah, size 11 if they have the thicker heel. The thin ones flatten by lunch on walking days.
Got it. Mom also asked if you can stop by Sunday before lunch.
I can. If tomorrow is another heavy parcel day, remind me not to wear the old gray pair.
You get a minute yet? I just stood behind the truck and inhaled half a sandwich.
Barely. Ate the pasta tub cold while sorting the next row.
At least you brought something. I was two seconds from pulling into Casey's.
Same thought crossed my mind, but the granola bar in the console saved me.
You got quiet after casing today. Knees or the supervisor mess?
Both probably. Emily texted before I even clocked out and asked if I was doing the drive-home silence thing.
She reads you fast. Skip the garage project tonight and put ice on it.
Already got the same order from her, plus soup waiting when I get in.
That was a lot of boxes for a Friday. You still stopping by the overlook tomorrow?
If my knee behaves. Tonight I am just going through last week's shots with headphones on.
Send me the one with the fog if it came out.
It needs a little straightening, but the light is decent.
Mark asked if we wanted to add more people for cards tomorrow.
I would rather keep it to you, Mark, and Aaron if he is off early.
That sounds more like an actual relaxing night for you.
Exactly. After the station was short today, I do not have much left.
If I drop the ladder by tomorrow, do I need to latch the side gate behind me?
No need. Nobody uses the yard unless Emily or I are out there.
Good. I'll set it near the garage and keep it off the flower bed.
Thanks. We'll both be gone until about 2, then back for the gutters.
My knee is still barking. You think I should give it another week?
If it hasn't eased up since Sunday, I'd call Monday. That's what Kline told me with my shoulder last year.
Fair. Your mother says the same. I saw something online about those spring shots and didn't know what to make of it.
I'd stick with your office or the county site. BJC had a plain chart too.
You still using that folding table Saturday or can I borrow it for Dad's garage?
Need it this weekend. Mike and Tricia are back over, and the dining table gets crowded once roads and bird cards come out.
No problem. I can grab it Sunday after lunch if it survives.
I saved the magazine page you left here. The one with the bright green hills and steam coming out of the ground.
Thanks, Mom. I was comparing that route with the coastal one that has the basalt columns.
It said April and May fill first, so don't wait too long if you need time off.
I know. I need to see what Emily thinks after we look at the deposit and flights.
Do you want me to move Sunday lunch later? You sounded worn out yesterday.
No, noon is fine. I finished at 44.5 this week, even with the extra window run.
All right. Bring the small envelope if you want me to help sort those clinic forms.
Thanks. I may take the open Tuesday slot before those payments hit.
How'd your legs hold up after the court last night? Route 12 has a lot of porch steps today.
Not terrible. I quit after two short runs and stretched before bed.
Smart. Keep the small bottle in the lunch bag, same as peak season.
It's in there. I'm spacing it out and taking the flat streets first.
Steward said your route-count sheet should list your original hire month, not just the last bid date.
Good catch. Mine should show March 2017 if they pull the full record.
Bring the dues line from your check too. They asked for mine when I fixed a similar mistake.
I will print it before Monday. Thanks.
When you stop at Schnucks, can you grab celery, spring mix, and another bag of flour?
Yep. The jar looked flat this morning, so I may give it until after dinner before trying anything.
Good call. Also we still have chicken bones in the freezer if you want the big pot going tomorrow.
I'll get lemons too. The dressing was too sharp last time.
I put the navy pullover by the couch. The one with the music note.
Perfect. I want it close for the second period if this turns into a nail-biter.
I also moved the laundry basket so you can see the whole TV from your chair.
Thanks. If Thomas gets one early, I may actually stay seated.
I found the flyer template you liked. Do you want it to say no charge, or just leave the price line off?
Put no charge. I do not want anyone skipping it because they think they need cash.
Okay. Two time blocks still: right after school and the slower midmorning one?
Yes. Same room if they approve it, and I can use leftover paper from Thursday's table.
Cards game at Dad's tomorrow? He said the back door will stay shut because everything outside is coated.
I'm in. I'll toss the little bottle and extra tissues in my jacket before we head over.
Bring enough for me too if you have spare. My truck dash looks like someone shook flour over it.
Yeah, I bought a two-pack Wednesday.
Mom asked if you still have the Washington copy or if I need to stop by the courthouse when I am over that way.
I have the copy. What I cannot find is the old address sheet from the place off F.
Check the box with the Francis Howell stuff and Dad's mower receipts. That is where half our St. Charles County paper trail ended up.
That sounds exactly like our filing system.
I found that folder from right after graduation. Do you still want the offer letter from the lab systems place?
No, toss it. That week of windowless screens was enough of a preview.
You sounded lighter once you were moving around and talking to people all day.
That part still fits. I am just trying to make the next step use my brain without putting me back in that room.
We saved you and Emily a plate for tomorrow if you can still come by after church.
We can. I'll bring the forms Dad left on the porch and go through them after we eat.
Thank you. Mark may come later, depending on his shift.
That works. Tell him he still owes me for making me drive him to practice all those years.
Fog is sitting low by the river. Still meeting at the Defiance lot at 7:30?
Yeah. I stretched already and packed an extra bottle.
Good. Let's keep the first couple miles slow and see how the legs feel.
Works for me. I want steady, not a race.
You still coming by after lunch? I found that old socket set.
Yep. Might be 20 minutes late. Mom asked what I thought about that county board item, so I pulled up the complaint timeline.
The one where the tape sat for months?
That one. I am not trying to start a table fight, but if someone misuses the job, a transfer and quiet paperwork should not be the whole story.
I can grab groceries after work. Do you want me to get the chips you like for the 6:45 start?
Yes please. I should be back from the route by the second inning if traffic behaves.
I'll leave your red pullover on the chair. It survived the wash.
Perfect. Maybe it brings better luck than Saturday.
That judge page you mentioned, was it in the blue folder from the last big November one?
Different folder. Blue was November. This one is the county printout and the League guide Emily grabbed at the library.
Bring it by when you come over. I mainly want the plain wording on those amendments.
Will do. I wrote notes next to the amendments already, but I want to read the local piece once more.
Could you and Emily stop by the fellowship hall Saturday after your route? The photo boards are too awkward for me to carry.
We can. Are these the county fair photos or the old family ones?
Mostly your grandpa's people from Kentucky and the German branch with the spelling nobody agrees on.
Got it. We will carry boards, but please do not put me near the choir signup sheet.
The dentist office called back. Crown estimate is $412 after insurance, but they can wait until April 2.
Let's do April 2. If it had to be today we could cover it, but I'd rather keep March clean.
Agreed. I also saw the automatic Friday move is still scheduled.
Good. I checked LiteBlue too, and the payroll line still matches what we set in January.
I picked up soup. You sent three thumbs-up in a row and nothing else, so I figured cooking was not happening.
Good call. I was staring at the address sheet and missed your question.
Leave it on the counter. We can look once, then close it.
I just need to stop comparing the same two house numbers.
Dad said he left the small cooler in your truck when you swung by Sunday.
Found it. Good timing, I had the soup jar, banana, and water rolling around loose.
Busy day?
Looks that way. If they push my break again, at least it won't be a vending-machine lunch.
Dad asked if you two were still coming for lunch Sunday. I have enough roast if you want to skip the place by the river.
Lunch at your house sounds better this week. We moved the little overnight anyway, so Sunday is open.
That works. Bring the coupon folder if you remember, and I will send leftovers home.
Heads up, clerks said two pallets of spring stuff came in for your side.
Figures. I brought the newer pair and the spare socks, so I'm as ready as I can be.
Good call. I switched pairs after Wednesday and felt less beat up by casing time.
Same here. The old ones are yard shoes now.
You still trying to make that Y thing after the route today?
Only if the rain holds off. I packed the helmet and light this morning.
Smart. My knees would riot after today's parcel load.
Mine are better when I keep the pace steady. I'll bail if the roads stay slick.
Weather app says clear at daybreak Sunday. You still thinking Klondike?
Maybe. I want that lower lot by the water before bikes fill it up.
Bring the camera then. Last time you caught the old guy loading fishing gear with the pink sky behind him.
That was a good one. If we finish early, I may swing through the little exhibit in town.
I found the longest-road marker under the couch. Also the blue train cards were mixed in with the bird sleeves.
That explains the missing stack. I will sort them before Mike and Tricia get here tomorrow.
Please do. Last time Tricia noticed before we even opened the snacks.
I will put each box by the window so we are not digging around at 7.
Do you still have any of those plug covers from when the cousins visited years ago?
I doubt it. The spare room is mostly Emily's books and my route gear now.
No worries. I figured your place stayed pretty uncluttered.
Mostly. Two dinner plates and a pile of laundry are enough for us.
I found the library board questionnaire you asked about. One candidate wants a company to run the desk hours.
Thanks. That answer bothered me. The librarians know the kids and older folks by name.
I thought you might say that. You were still unsure on the tax question?
Still reading. I like the library funding part, less sure about the county vehicle fee.
Storm line looks like it reaches us around ten. Are you and Emily staying in?
Yes. We moved the chairs in and I told Dale to text if the branch by his drive comes down.
Thank you. I like knowing you all compare notes when the sky gets rough.
That's one reason I like being out here. You hear the rain first, then three phones buzz.
Dad wants to know if you two can bring the folding table tomorrow.
Yeah. Emily put it by the back door last night with the Cardinals cooler.
She also told Mom you looked wiped, so I can handle Dad's mower belt if you need to keep it short.
Appreciate it. She saw me pacing with the mail tubs still in my head.
Mom mentioned the fish fry tonight. You inviting anybody besides Emily?
Probably just Aaron if he answers after his casing is done.
Works for me. Easier to grab one table that way.
That is what I was thinking. I already see enough faces during the week.
Did you ever pick a cheap camera for hikes, or are you still in tab overload?
Still comparing. Reddit has better real sample shots, YouTube has the menu walk-throughs. Hard to tell what is useful until somebody uses it outside.
Sounds like you. I need a simple answer, not homework.
Same problem with the little sensor kit. I watched one Python example and now I have three more saved.
Cardinals are slow tonight. You still working through that doorstop book with all the moons?
Yeah. It is better than the score so far. I am near the part where the crew splits up.
Bring it Sunday if you finish. I want to see why it needs 700 pages.
I will toss it in the car. You may just flip to the maps and hand it back.
I printed the library flyer you mentioned. It says the speaker is taking questions after.
Thanks. I may just listen. The zip-code chart from last time stuck with me more than I expected.
Listening first is fine. Do you want me to save the donation envelope from the table?
Yes, please. Nothing big, but I can put a little in if they are helping families with complaint forms.
Could you print one of those daffodil pictures for the refrigerator when you have time?
Sure. I was going to sit with those after dinner and fix the color a bit.
No rush. I liked the one by the mailbox.
That one is in the batch. I have a record set aside for it.
Klondike trail looks dry by late morning. You free before noon?
Not this one. Mom has us doing the little brick place first, then lunch with the photo-board crowd.
The basement coffee and old-song place?
Yep. I should escape by 12:30 unless the cousins restart Kentucky versus Indiana over the Mullins line.
You still need that old cast iron pot? I can bring it over after lunch.
That would help. Mine scorched the bottom when I had the broth going and then tried the covered bake.
I will bring the scraper too. Your mother asked if you want more pint jars.
Yes, a few. I keep filling them with chopped vegetables for workdays.
If you are coming after church, bring that Washington paper. The seal on the corner looks faint and I want to see if the scanner helped.
Will do. I also found the envelope with the county bus pass and the old Defiance postmark.
Good. That envelope should have the F-road mailbox number too.
Dad asked why your paycheck has that little branch deduction every two weeks. He was sorting papers again.
Tell him it is normal. Same line has been there since the first year I started carrying.
So almost a decade of those tiny printouts. No wonder your folder is thick.
March makes year nine. I should probably thin the folder before Sunday lunch.
Still want to hike Saturday morning, or are you saving your knee for the Busch trip?
Short hike is fine. I just need to be back early enough to shower and head downtown.
Fair. I saw the forecast says wind off the river, so bring that red jacket.
Already by the door with the tickets. Hoping they don't make the 8th inning stressful.
Still want the Katy Trail loop Saturday, or should we keep it flatter after this parcel mess?
Flat is better. I am doing the mat routine tonight and Friday so I do not start the hike stiff.
Works. I will skip the rocky spur by the creek.
Good call. Downhill steps after a heavy week are usually what remind me I should have paced myself.
You heading out for a short walk after casing tomorrow? Weather looks decent.
Probably. This week has me jumpy by supper, and if I sit with the phone I keep opening the same bad headlines.
Leave it in the truck cab for the first mile. I did that Tuesday and actually came home less wired.
That is the plan. Walk, shower, then no screen in the room.
I left the St. Charles County link and the BJC page in your notes app.
Thanks. I'll read them before I pick a Saturday slot.
And call if that cough is still dragging by lunch. No need to tough it out forever.
That's the plan. If Family Care has an opening, I'll take it.
Are you still meeting them at the church gym after dinner?
Only if they need a fifth. I put the brace by my shoes and I'm keeping it short.
There are two tablets left in the kitchen bottle, so don't count on it unless you stop somewhere.
I'll grab a new bottle tomorrow. Tonight's plan is warm up, one run, then home.
I looked at the spreadsheet. If you skip the new lens for now, the May deposit is not as impossible as it felt.
That makes me feel better. The leader's notes about low clouds over the craters are still stuck in my head.
Then email your two questions tonight: knee-friendly walking pace and what happens if the weather pins everyone down.
I will. If there is a seat left, I don't want to talk myself out of it again.
You ever get that new hand unit to stop freezing?
Mostly. I still mark the weird stops in pencil so I'm not trusting the screen alone when I'm loading in a hurry.
Same idea as shop tags. Write it where you'll see it before the mistake happens.
Yep. Today it kept me from burying three Cedar Lane boxes under the flats, and I made the pickup window.
Game starts at 6:45. You firing up the back porch setup before first pitch?
Yeah, quick tray first for dinner, then the rack can stay on while we watch the early innings.
Save me one of the crispy edge pieces if I swing by after Dad's.
I'll keep some aside. Emily already claimed the garlic-herb strips.
If we get rain Saturday, want to swap the hike for coffee and that bookstore in St. Peters?
That works. I wanted to check the used shelf anyway. Last time they had a whole row of old rocket-cover paperbacks.
Figures. I will look at trail maps while you dig through the dusty ones.
You still hiking Klondike after work or calling it?
Calling it. I keep going back through the parcel notes and I'm already dragging.
Makes sense. I noticed you were doing the nod-and-point routine at the case instead of talking.
Yeah. I just want to get the scanner list clean and go home.
That empty-netter made the last five minutes a lot less ugly.
I was pacing after the bad clear. Worth staying up for two points though.
You still wearing that note cap tomorrow at work?
If anyone brings up the second period, yes. Quietly.
Radar looks clear until 8. Your bottle is filled and the reflective band is on the counter.
Thanks. Meeting at the Y at 6:35 if the others still show.
Text me after, especially if your route gets heavy again.
Cleaner confirmed for 8:30 Monday. I told her it is only our bedroom, the hall bath, kitchen, and living room.
Good. I'll move my boots and the mail bins before I leave.
She asked about bowls, crates, or gates to work around. I said none, just watch the loose hallway rug.
Perfect. I'll leave the check on the counter with both our names on the note.
Dinner can wait a bit. You came in tight-shouldered.
I am going to do one lap by the water first. Camera is already in the car.
Take the gray notebook too. The last bridge sketch made you less clipped when you got back.
Good call. I will be back before 8.
If we go into St. Louis tomorrow, can you send me the post with that Cherokee Street window display?
Sent it from IG. The same account had a reel from the clay studio near the corner too.
Nice. Also, please do not spend the whole evening comparing lenses again.
Too late. I have one YouTube tab left and a Reddit thread with side-by-side crops, then I am done.
Your mother says don't forget the insurance card Monday.
It's in my glove box. I'll pick you both up at 9:20.
Mark called too. He said you still have the ratchet set he tried to borrow.
He can have it after he admits I was right about the Cardinals bullpen.
Can you swing by Saturday with that socket set, or are you tied up at the station?
I took the 7-11 help shift, then I can come by after lunch.
That makes a long week. Don't rush over if your knee is barking.
I'll be okay. It lands around 47 by Friday, and the extra half-day helps with the roof deposit.
Did that young fellow at work get his scanner straightened out?
Yeah. We walked through it by the dock, then I had him explain it back before we clocked out.
That is how you learn a system. Same as a mower belt, just less grease.
Exactly. The old cubicle-track version of me would have written a clean report about the jam. This way I can see it, fix it, and maybe get to change how it is set up.
Dad has a stack of clean peanut-butter jars if your Defiance project can use them.
Yes, save them. They would work for brush water or button sorting, and I can wash labels off Sunday.
Need me to ask around for more cans too, or is the food box the bigger issue?
Both help. The box empties faster than I expect, and the jars keep the supply list cheap.
You free to help Dad with that mower belt tomorrow, or did your Saturday loop get dumped on again?
I can come by after. They added a chunk near Cottleville, but I should be done by 2 if the scanner behaves.
Bring the knee brace then. Last time you showed up walking like the driveway won.
Fair. Too many porch steps this week. I'll text when I leave the station.
Dad asked if you are still helping him compare the council candidates Sunday. He says the TV ads are all noise.
Yes. I printed the questionnaire and circled the ones who answered straight on keeping ambulance dispatch with the county.
That one got my attention too. I am not sold on handing that phone room to the lowest bidder.
Same. I still split a few races, but on that service question I know where I land.
I moved Sunday lunch inside. The porch table is covered again and the breeze is kicking up.
Thanks. I'll take one of the 24hr tablets before I leave and keep my route hat in the truck.
Good. I put a clean hand towel by the bathroom sink for when you get here.
Do you and Emily still need my extra casserole dish for Sunday?
I found the receipt for the medicine cabinet parts. Do you need the exact amount for your house file?
Yes please. She is making the potatoes and I am doing the chicken after I mop.
Yes, send it when you can. I’m putting house fixes under a separate tab so they don’t get mixed in with regular March stuff.
$42.68 at Lowe’s. Your father says the hinges were the good kind.
I will bring it. Did that bank letter about the house payment get sorted out?
Mostly. Emily found the statement and I called them during lunch, so we just need to file it.
Got it. I’ll add it before Emily and I settle up Sunday.
I swapped off the later run. Matson Hill at 9 still good?
Yes. Just us this time; I told Mark I would catch him Sunday.
Fine by me. Quiet trail beats standing around after yesterday.
No argument. I will bring coffee and meet by the lower lot.
For the file folder, do you want the Washington scan in the same sleeve as the Defiance address notes?
Yes, keep those together. The St. Charles County school papers can go behind them.
Done. I labeled it by year instead of trying to decode your parents' old envelope system.
That is probably the only way anyone will find it again.
I put the blue ice pack back in the freezer and left your black pair by the mat.
Thanks. Today was all porches and long driveways, so I'm taking the stairs slowly.
Then let's do dinner at home. Also, the receipt from Fleet Feet is still on the counter if you need it.
Keep it there. If these keep working, I'll get the same model before the next rush.
I put your clean wool socks by the door. Are you doing the Katy stretch before we drive into St. Louis?
If I wake up on time, yes. Just the shorter section so my legs are not shot for the museum.
Take the smaller pack then. The big one makes you load it like you are gone all day.
Fair. Socks, water, snack, and home.
I saw you left the oversight packet on the counter. Want to talk through it before bed or save it?
A few minutes is good. I keep coming back to why the review started only after the footage request.
That part jumped out to me too. Also the map in the appendix.
Yeah. I bookmarked the local group's notes and sent them another $10. Small, but I would rather keep learning than just grumble at the TV.
If you take the back way this morning, the south shoulder past the boat ramp is chewed up.
Thanks. I was going to pull in there for a few minutes before the St. Louis museum run.
Use the gravel patch by the sign. Better angle and you won't sink a tire.
Good call. I only need a quick pass if the light is still coming off the river.
You going into St. Charles tonight for the game?
Probably staying put. Emily wants soup, the windows open, and the frogs are already loud by the creek.
Fair. Dad said 94 had deer moving early after that rain.
Another reason to stay here. If your porch delivery shows late, tell Mom I can have Nancy watch for it from across the lane.
You still keeping those marked sheets? I found one from that governor year in my glove box.
Mine go in the file cabinet after each one. Sounds boring, but it saves me when the same tax or road language comes back.
Send me the link you used for the fire district thing. The mailer made it sound too simple.
I'll send the county PDF and the St. Charles paper writeup. I checked both before I marked mine.
